**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

That there exists no recourse for citizens (1)/ if environmental violations are condoned at the ministerial level (2)/ underline a systemic erosion of (3)/ constitutional accountability. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. underline a systemic erosion of .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**underline a systemic erosion of**" is incorrect because the verb "**underline**" does not align with the subject "**that there exists no recourse for citizens**." It should instead be replaced with "**underlines**" to correctly match the singular subject.
 
• This error is related to subject-verb agreement, where a singular subject requires a singular verb.
 
• The corrected sentence should read: "*That there exists no recourse for citizens if environmental violations are condoned at the ministerial level **underlines** a systemic erosion of constitutional accountability.*"

Correct sentence: *That there exists no recourse for citizens if environmental violations are condoned at the ministerial level **underlines** a systemic erosion of constitutional accountability.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**
 
 
• Ensure the verb agrees with the subject in number (singular/plural).
 
• Example: "**He runs**" vs "**They run**".
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Misalignment between subject and verb.
 
• Ignoring singular/plural forms.
